# SMP Utilities+

SMP Utilities+ is a lightweight and performance-focused modpack designed to enhance your Minecraft experience without changing the core vanilla feel. Perfect for SMP servers and survival players who want smoother gameplay and useful quality-of-life improvements.

This modpack combines powerful optimization mods with essential utilities to boost FPS, reduce lag, and improve overall performance — even on low-end PCs.

## ✨ Features:

- 🚀 High FPS & smooth gameplay (optimized for performance)             
- 🛠️ Useful utility mods to improve your gameplay experience             
- 🌍 Perfect for SMP servers and multiplayer             
- ⚡ Fast loading times and reduced lag spikes             
- 🎮 Keeps the vanilla style while making everything better             
 
Whether you're exploring, building, or playing with friends, SMP Utilities+ gives you a cleaner, faster, and more enjoyable Minecraft experience.
